phases.name: Data Cleanup, Mock Purge & Slot 2 WebM Activation
phases.summary: Backed up mascot.json to mascot.json.bak. Bound Slot 2 Core Thinking to valid 192-frame VP9 WebM transparent video artifact with registration. Purged all 39 synthetic mock atlas.png fixtures across Core and Police styles while preserving 20 valid high-res 3D character images. Verified 0 atlas references and schema validation passed 100%.

phases.name: Domain Contracts & Media Availability Filter
phases.summary: Implemented isMascotVariantAvailable predicate, filterAvailableVariants, and resolveStateVariantWithFallback in @studio/shared (packages/shared/src/mascot/animation/variantAvailability.ts). Rejects empty slots, failed statuses, and mock fixture identifiers. Integrated availability filtering and graceful omission into productionMascotStateAdapter. Created 16 unit tests in mascotAvailability.test.ts with 100% pass rate.

phases.name: Per-Question Uniform Random Selector Engine
phases.summary: Implemented selectQuestionMascotVariant and selectQuestionMascotVariantResult in @studio/shared (packages/shared/src/mascot/animation/animationVariantSelector.ts). Features media availability filtering, uniform random deterministic selection via FNV-1a seed, consecutive repeat avoidance when available variants >= 2, and seamless support for both static 3D character images and transparent WebM video variants. Wired into productionMascotStateAdapter.ts eliminating index-based modulo round-robin and synthesizing stable identifiers for preview/sandbox scenes. Created 15 unit tests in questionVariantSelector.test.ts verifying zero variants, single variant, determinism, repeat avoidance, and uniform distribution with 100% pass rate.

phases.name: Production Video Rendering Pipeline Integration
phases.summary: Wired per-question uniform variant selector into candyArcadeComposition.ts with previousSlotIndex chaining and snapshot tracking. Implemented transparent WebM video handling with deterministic seekTimeSeconds in productionMascotTimeline.ts, rendering with CSS keyframe motion in mascotHtmlRenderer.ts, and clean omission (null/invisible) of mascot layers for 0-variant states without breaking composition duration or timeline events. Added comprehensive integration tests in mascotRendererIntegration.test.ts verifying 5-question multi-clip randomization, video vs static rendering, and 0-variant omission with 100% pass rate.

phases.name: Preview Surfaces Synchronization
phases.summary: Synchronized Visual Sandbox, Stage Studio, and Episode Preview surfaces with stable question context and media availability rules. In sandboxComposition.ts, bound stable identifiers (videoId: parsed.episode_id || 'sandbox_preview', questionId: parsed.question_id || ('sandbox_q_' + questionIndex)), enabling dynamic deterministic question variant rotation and rendering Slot 2 transparent WebM video. In apps/web Mascot Studio components (VariantSlotCard, AnimationProcessingSlotCard, AnimationSlotCard, MascotAnimationCanvas, ManifestFrameCanvas, QuizStagePlacementPreview), added native <video> element playback for transparent WebM videos, filtered mock fixtures with isMockFixtureIdentifier, and replaced broken fixtures with clean 'No variant generated' placeholders. In buildEpisodePreviewRequest.ts, propagated episode_id and question_id ensuring 100% WYSIWYG variant parity between preview iframe and server render pipeline. Added automated integration and unit tests passing 100% (70/70 in sandboxComposition, 133/133 test suites across web).

phases.name: Full Regression Suite & Verification
phases.summary: Completed full regression suite and live verification. Executed all test suites: @studio/shared (300/300 passed), @studio/web (696/696 passed across 133 files), @studio/server (331+ test files, 2690+ passed; mascot verification tests 117/117 passed). Full monorepo typecheck passed with 0 errors. Verified disk mascot profile against schema (0 mock atlas references remaining, Slot 2 Core Thinking active with 192-frame VP9 WebM, Core Slots 1 and 3..10 active with valid 3D images). Verified secondary style fallback and clean omission of missing variant states.
